method: Fresh Three.js AnimationMixer playback of frozen delivered GLB; all vertices weighted >50% to a foot are transformed. Sampled at120Hz, including all30Hz keys and three interior points per interval. No live IK, target positions, or source choreography are used. Generic bridge clearance is independently compared with3mm+22mm*smoothstep(horizontal foot speed/0.5m/s); four retained-gait transitions are exempt.
limitations: Inferred near-floor windows are observations, not authored stance declarations; their drift does not establish a planted-foot QA result.
Reported peak speeds use consecutive120Hz differences; the independent clearance check uses centered differences.
Surface minimum samples vertices, not triangle collisions.

denseTrace.defaultReport: Per-bridge metrics, endpoint/worst samples and every floor-failure sample. Full120Hz traces are regenerated by this script.
